**Paris Get‑Away Itinerary (7 Days)** *(Assumes you’re flying into Charles de Gaulle Airport and staying in a centrally located boutique hotel or Airbnb in the 1st–7th arrondissements.)* | Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening | |-----|---------|-----------|---------| | **Day 1 – Arrival & Orientation** | • Arrive, clear customs, take a taxi or RER B to your accommodation.
• Check‑in, freshen up. | • Walk to the Louvre’s courtyard; grab a coffee at Café Marly.
• Quick stroll through the Tuileries Garden. | • Dinner at Le Coupe Chou (classic French bistro).
• Night walk along the Seine, see the Eiffel Tower sparkle. | | **Day 2 – Classic Landmarks** | • Early breakfast at a local boulangerie.
• Visit Notre‑Dame & Sainte‑Chapelle (book tickets online). | • Lunch at a café in the Latin Quarter.
• Explore Île de la Cité & Île Saint‑Louis. | • Seine river cruise (night cruise optional). | | **Day 3 – Art & Culture** | • Breakfast at Angelina (famous hot chocolate).
• Musée d’Orsay (reserve skip‑the‑line tickets). | • Lunch near the museum.
• Walk to Musée Rodin (beautiful gardens). | • Dinner at Le Procope (oldest café in Paris). | | **Day 4 – Montmartre & Sacré‑Coeur** | • Breakfast at a local patisserie.
• Take Metro Line 12 to Abbesses; explore Montmartre streets. | • Visit Sacré‑Coeur Basilica; panoramic city view.
• Lunch at La Maison Rose. | • Attend a cabaret show at Moulin Rouge or Lido. | | **Day 5 – Shopping & Gardens** | • Breakfast at a café near your hotel.
• Explore the Champs‑Élysées; shop at Galeries Lafayette. | • Lunch at Ladurée (macarons).
• Visit the Arc de Triomphe (climb to the top). | • Dinner at a Michelin‑starred restaurant (e.g., Septime) – book well in advance. | | **Day 6 – Day Trip** | • Take a train to Versailles (RER C).
• Tour the Palace & Hall of Mirrors. | • Picnic lunch in the palace gardens. | • Return to Paris; casual dinner at a brasserie. | | **Day 7 – Departure** | • Pack, check‑out. | • Last‑minute souvenir shopping at Rue de Rivoli. | • Head to the airport via RER B or taxi. | ### Practical Tips | Topic | Recommendation | |-------|----------------| | **Transport** | Buy a *carnet* of 10 single‑ride tickets for Metro/RER. Consider a *Paris Visite* pass for unlimited travel on public transport. | | **Accommodation** | Stay within 1–7 arrondissements for easy access to major sights. Look for hotels with free Wi‑Fi and a good breakfast. | | **Dining** | Reserve tables at popular restaurants 2–3 days ahead. Try local specialties: croissants, escargot, coq au vin, crème brûlée. | | **Tickets** | Book major attractions (Louvre, Musée d’Orsay, Eiffel Tower, Versailles) online to avoid queues. | | **Language** | Learn basic French phrases; most Parisians speak English in tourist areas. | | **Safety** | Keep an eye on your belongings in crowded places. Avoid carrying large amounts of cash. | | **Weather** | Pack layers; Paris weather can be unpredictable. Bring an umbrella and comfortable walking shoes. | Enjoy your Paris adventure! If you’d like a more detailed day‑by‑day schedule, specific restaurant reservations, or a budget breakdown, just let me know.
